meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 不再走 OneCLI 网关,而是从 .env 文件读取 Anthropic 的密钥或令牌,直接注入容器供 API 调用使用。
howto.when: 当 .env 里设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 并填入 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY、CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN 等凭据,重启服务后触发。

say.text: 帮我改用 .env 里的 Anthropic 密钥,不走 OneCLI 网关
say.note: 会检查并接线原生凭据代理。

say.text: 用 Claude 订阅令牌连接,把令牌写进 .env
say.note: 会引导运行 claude setup-token 并配置。

howto.what_en: With it enabled, Claude no longer uses the OneCLI gateway; the Anthropic key or token is read from .env and injected directly into the container's environment for API calls.
howto.when_en: It activates when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env and at least one credential (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN) is present, after the service is restarted.

say_en.text: Switch to the Anthropic key in .env and skip the OneCLI gateway.
say_en.note: It wires up the native credential proxy.

say_en.text: Set NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true and read credentials from .env.
say_en.note: It sets the flag and restarts to verify.

say_en.text: Use my Claude subscription token by writing it into .env.
say_en.note: It guides you through claude setup-token.
